en: A vintage illustrated postcard showing a busy European town square lined with tall historic buildings featuring gabled roofs and arcades. In the center stands a large fountain or monument surrounded by people and market stalls with umbrellas. In the background, on a hill, there is a clock tower overlooking the city. The scene is rendered in a detailed line drawing. At the bottom right, decorative script text reads "Graz, Hauptplatz," and a small imprint credits an atelier.
